name: multiply
description: Multiply two numbers and return the exact product. Use this for any multiplication instead of working it out yourself.

name: get_current_time
description: Return the current local date and time on this device. Use this whenever the answer depends on what time it is now.

name: get_device_info
description: Return the platform this app is running on. Use this when asked about the device, the operating system, or where the app is running.
